newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian infrastructure fund issue set.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian infrastructure fund issue set.

text.p: Hastings Funds Management Ltd said it plans to launch an infrastructure fund vehicle, the Australian Infrastructure Fund (AIF), with a A$175 million issue of stapled securities at A$2 each.

It said AIF has been designed for retail investors and consists of five unlisted infrastructure investments not previously available to the public as well as A$13 million of Melbourne's Transurban City Link.
The fund will initially be more than 50 percent invested and have an annualised yield of 8.2 percent, Hastings said.
The offer opened on Monday and closes on February 21.
Trading of the stapled securities on the Australian Stock Exchange is expected to commence on March 6, Hastings said.

The portfolio of unlisted initial investments comprises the Sydney Light Rail Co, Yallourn Energy, a Victorian power station operator, Statewide Roads, operator of Sydney's M4 toll road, South Australian gas pipeline operator EPIC Energy and United Energy, a Melbourne electricity retailer and distributor.
